concept.title: Wireless smartphone charging system
concept.shortdesc: A wireless smartphone charging system is located in front of the center console.

keywords.indexterm: interior features wireless smartphone charging system

conbody.p: Firmly close all doors, and turn the EV button to POWER ON or DRIVE READY position. To start wireless charging, place the smartphone equipped with wireless charging function on the wireless charging pad (1).
For best wireless charging results, place the smartphone on the center of the charging pad.

The wireless charging system is designed for one smartphone equipped with QI only. Please refer to the smartphone accessory cover or the smartphone manufacturer homepage to check whether your smartphone supports QI function.

note.p: During wireless charging, an internal fan operates to prevent overheating. Fan noise may sound.
If any metallic object such as coins is located between the wireless charging system and the smartphone, the charging may be disrupted. Also, the metallic object may heat up.
